"templateId": "38f6f55e-df4b-5f05-add9-9567bda77073",
"title": "Run debt refinance review checklist",
"text": "Complete these checks before recommending a refinance:\n\n- Confirm current loan type, balance, interest rate, payment, remaining term, and prepayment penalties.\n- Gather proposed refinance rate, term, payment, closing costs, points, and escrow changes.\n- Calculate breakeven period using total refinance costs and monthly payment change.\n- Compare total interest cost under current loan versus proposed loan if held through the expected time horizon.\n- Check whether the refinance extends debt beyond retirement or another planning milestone.\n- Review cash flow impact, emergency reserve impact, and debt-to-income considerations.\n- Identify tax considerations, including mortgage interest deductibility assumptions where relevant.\n- Confirm whether credit score, income documentation, appraisal, or title issues could affect approval.\n- Note non-financial reasons for refinancing, such as payment stability, removing a borrower, or consolidating debt.\n- Document recommendation, assumptions, and unresolved lender questions.\nAssess the $38,000 home equity line at 8.1% and the $210,000 mortgage at 3.25% to determine whether paying down the line, refinancing, or maintaining the current structure best meets Rowan Cloudpuddle’s cash reserve target and retirement income plan.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-03-11",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "They agreed to assess whether paying down the line, refinancing, or leaving it in place is most consistent with the cash reserve target and retirement income plan, with a date of 2026-03-11."
